_comment: Plugin hook registration for the SageReasoning seven-layer reference harness (H1–H5; Trust Layer S8 generalized the Gate-1 full-loop harness onto the seven-layer anatomy — see ../SEVEN-LAYERS.md for the channel-law classification). Auto-discovered at the plugin root (hooks/hooks.json) on install. Paths use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} in EXEC form. 'timeout' is SECONDS; the hooks self-abort under their own budgets and return their honest result first. H1 (UserPromptSubmit) frames the top-level task. H2 (PreToolUse matcher Task|Agent) frames each delegated subagent's task AND — when the discernment surface is provisioned (discernment.config.json; see lib/discernment.mjs) — runs the spawn-time four-layer discernment + out-of-band L4 audit via the dark /api/practice/discernment route and prepends the A9 authority boundary (its timeout is 120s to cover the discernment budget; un-provisioned installs finish in the old ~28s envelope). H3 (PreToolUse matcher Bash|Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit) is the R5 at-action cadence — guard + Gate-2 consult (deduped) + loop-closure + the once-per-session trust-verdict advisory (S8). H4 (Stop) is reflect-at-close + the accreditation write. H5 (PostToolUse matcher Task|Agent) is the S8 delegation hand-back — POSTs the sub-spawn's signed artifacts for A9 justice-failure classification + the A8/A9 trust-event emission (INSTRUMENT; never alters the tool result). The consult credential is read from SAGE_GATE1_CREDENTIAL; H4's accreditation write uses a SEPARATE non-marker credential SAGE_GATE1_ACCRED_CREDENTIAL (never the standing marker) + SAGE_GATE1_AGENT_ID. All S8 surfaces are DARK until SUBSTRATE_TRUST_CORE_ENABLED is set server-side (the route answers 503; the hooks fail open honestly). See ../README.md + ../KILL-SWITCHES.md.
